name: Stremio
description: Unofficial Stremio client for the PS5
author: Argyris Vazaios
release_notes:
Version 1.0 is a full redesign of the app. Every screen was rebuilt from scratch.

Stremio now lives in the Games section of the PlayStation home screen. From 1.0 it is a game-type title (before, it was under Media). It also gets all of the console's direct memory (about 11 GB instead of about 2 GB), which the artwork and the video decoder use.

Besides the new look:
- Hardware decoding reworked for the new interface: the video goes from the console's decoder to the GPU for display, and the player shows whether hardware or software decoding is in use.
- Continue Watching picks up where you left off: it plays the same episode with the same stream, at the point where you stopped, and after a finished episode it goes on to the next one.
- Circle always takes you back, all the way to the Board.
- The video pauses by itself when you press the PS button.
- Faster, sharper pictures: posters and wallpapers load before the home screen is shown, and higher-resolution wallpapers are used where they exist.
- Soft interface sounds when you move around, switch page or go back (turn them off in Settings, Interface sounds).
- Search opens the PS5's own keyboard, at the top right of the screen.
- Everything of 0.3.x is still here: the built-in torrent engine, direct links, subtitles (including Arabic and Hebrew) and sign-in with a code.

Install: copy PPSA77711.ffpfsc to /data/homebrew/ on the console. ShadowMountPlus registers it; start Stremio from the Games section of the home screen and sign in in Settings.

Update from an earlier version: close Stremio, delete the old PPSA77711.ffpfsc, wait a few seconds, then copy the new one. (It is now a game-type title, so it moves from Media to Games.)
